Following a brutal betrayal that shatters his family's syndicate, a ruthless Italian mob enforcer embarks on a relentless campaign of vengeance across the shadowed streets of Palermo. As he systematically dismantles the rival empire responsible for his ruin, he must confront the decaying morality of the underworld and the haunting cost of his own blood-soaked loyalty. Trapped in a deadly game of betrayal and power, he realizes that the ultimate price of revenge might just be his own soul.
